questions.explanation: Eutrophication occurs when excess nutrients (such as nitrates from fertilisers) wash into waterways, causing algal blooms. The algae block light, killing aquatic plants. When the algae die, decomposing bacteria use up oxygen, causing fish and other organisms to suffocate.
